packageRules.description: Immutable-ref housekeeping (pin, pinDigest) automerges. Digest, patch and minor updates also automerge, through the org's inherited rules, once checks pass; nothing here holds them for a person.

Third-party GitHub Actions (everything except first-party projectbluefin/**) automerge only once their release is three days old, so a compromised release has time to be spotted and pulled upstream before it lands here. Same decision as finpilot#645. First-party projectbluefin/** actions are not delayed.

Give action bumps in the three release workflows their own pull request. The hive lets a trusted bot merge a pure pin bump to these files without a person (its pin-only exception), but only when every file in the pull request is one of them; grouped with other workflows, as in #1127, the bump always waits for a person.
KDE runner image and Python requirements
Keep the VM jobs on Ubuntu 24.04: bootc's loopback install fails on 26.04 runners (#1123, #1131). Drop this once the install works there.

Don't offer updates to the npm pin under constraints: it must match the npm version CI runs (Node 26 ships npm 11), not the newest npm (#1257 was closed for this). Raise it in the same change that moves CI to a newer npm; dashboard/scripts/check-npm-pin.mjs fails the dashboard build until then.
A Node major brings a newer bundled npm. Remind whoever merges it to raise constraints.npm in the same PR, since updates to that pin are switched off above.
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** this Node version may bundle a newer npm. Check `npm --version` in this PR's CI log and set `constraints.npm` in `renovate.json` to match, in this same PR.

packageRules.description: A major update always waits for a person. automerge false only stops Renovate; the hive merges trusted-bot pull requests itself, so label the update needs-owner-merge (the hive's auto_merge.human_merge_labels default): the hive never merges a PR with it, and only the owner's merge click lands it. hold was used first (#1233) but a held PR merges as soon as someone removes hold. The hive merged #1229 and #1230 before any label, and #1230 broke the dashboard publish. Last matching rule wins, so keep this rule last.
